summary: This is a financial summary table comparing reported IFRS and adjusted non-IFRS values for various financial metrics as of December 31 for the years 2024 and 2025. The reported Operating Profit for 2025 is 8,355 with an adjustment for Labour Codes of 1,289, leading to an adjusted non-IFRS value of 9,644. The Operating Margin % is 18.4 for 2025, adjusted to 21.2. Profit before income taxes is reported at 9,229, with an adjustment of 1,289, resulting in an adjusted non-IFRS value of 10,518. The Income tax expense is 2,563, with an adjustment of 318, leading to an adjusted non-IFRS value of 2,881. The Net Profit after non-controlling interests is 6,654 for 2025, adjusted to 7,625. The Basic EPS is reported at 16.17, adjusted to 18.53. For 2024, the reported values are Operating Profit of 8,912, Operating Margin % of 21.3, Profit before income taxes of 9,670, Income tax expense of 2,848, Net Profit of 6,806, and Basic EPS of 16.43.
